I’m not able to pull live data or browse the web, so I can’t give you a real‑time “current” list of releases. However, based on what’s been announced and released up through mid‑2024, here are some of the most talked‑about films that hit theaters (or streaming platforms) around this time:

| Release window | Title | Genre / Notes |
|-----------------|-------|---------------|

| | *Killers of the Flower Moon* | Martin Scorsese drama – high‑profile cast and Oscar nominations. |
| | *Dune: Part Two* | Sci‑fi sequel – huge fan anticipation following the 2021 release. |
| | *Wonka* | Prequel to Willy Wonka – family‑friendly, big box‑office draw. |
| **Mid‑2024** | *Mission: Impossible – Dead Reckoning Part One* | Action‑thriller – part of a long‑running franchise. |
| | *The Hunger Games: The Ballad of Songbirds & Snakes* | New take on the YA dystopia series. |
| | *The Little Mermaid* | Disney live‑action remake – strong marketing push. |

Those sites will have the most up‑to‑date listings, trailers, and reviews.
